name: user-vlm-UserVQA-bench
description:
VLM Benchmark for Personalized Responses
	

To assess the personalization capabilities of the User-VLM compared to the baseline, we employed this benchmark:

User-VQA Bench: Consisting of 500 test samples from Alexa-VQA and AlpaGasus-VQA, this benchmark serves as an additional evaluation set.

Notably, the model was not trained on any entries from these benchmarks, ensuring an unbiased evaluation of its personalization and generalization capabilities.
